summary: Aon North America, Inc. and Aon Global Holdings plc filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a multi-tranche senior notes offering, with maturities from 2029 through 2056 and full guarantees from Aon plc, Aon Corporation and Aon Global Limited. The 2029-2038 tranches are designated 'USI Acquisition Notes,' indicating debt financing related to an acquisition, but this filing is the ordinary shelf takedown itself, not a special-situations event. Deal size, coupons, and pricing are left blank. Watch pricing spreads and any overhang tied to acquisition financing needs.
